name: WorkOS 'Your app, Enterprise Ready.' social card by workos.com
description: A 1200×630 share card built almost entirely from typography. The near-white canvas carries a faint diagonal diamond lattice that fades out on the left, keeping the text zone clean while adding texture to the empty right half. Hierarchy is handled by a two-line, left-aligned headline in a heavy grotesque: line one sits in solid near-black, line two runs purple-to-teal in a horizontal gradient, so the colour shift — not a size or weight change — marks the emphasis. A small logo-plus-wordmark lockup anchors the bottom-left like a signature, and the rest is deliberate negative space with no tagline, URL, or imagery competing for attention.
